name: SIGMA - Suspicious Query of MachineGUID via reg.exe
author: frack113 (original rule), Yohan Landji (Cyberlandji) (PB-02 adaptation)
description:
Detects use of reg.exe to read the HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Cryptography MachineGuid
value - a stable per-install host identifier that infostealers (Lumma among them) use to
fingerprint the victim. Emulated as Magpie node 6 (Atomic Red Team T1082 test #9) and
validated against the PB-02 detonation: the canonical SigmaHQ rule fired on the reg.exe
leaf event unchanged, so this is an attribution-preserving adaptation, not a logic change.
false_positives: Rare. Some inventory/telemetry software reads MachineGuid, but usually via the registry API rather than a reg.exe child process, which this rule does not match.
query: process.executable.caseless:*\\reg.exe AND (process.command_line:*SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Cryptography* AND process.command_line:*\/v\ * AND process.command_line:*MachineGuid*)
